failure_summary.description: Agents repeated searches, failed to filter cached results for newly added criteria, or ran unrelated proximity operations.
Agents saved an undefined variable or the search function instead of the result returned by the tool.
A requested round trip was represented as an arrival date on the outbound flight rather than a separate reverse-direction leg.
Agents inferred an unsupported party size, omitted a requested neighborhood, or supplied an invalid flight-time value.

patch.reasoning: The existing skill already directly instructs agents to reuse compatible cached results and filter them, bind and save returned result objects, model return flights as separate reverse-direction legs, avoid inferring party size from vague family language, map neighborhoods correctly, and use the accepted flight-time format. These failures reflect noncompliance with existing guidance rather than an uncovered skill gap, so adding duplicative instructions is not warranted.
